visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair looks directly at the camera. Her face exhibits numerous small, red, raised circular marks and slight swelling, particularly in the area under her lower eyelids. She wears a brown textured robe with gold trim. The lighting is warm and bright, typical of a modern indoor facility. (2) The woman stands in front of a mirror in a dimly lit room, holding a smartphone with a red case to take a selfie. Her entire face is covered in a thick layer of white numbing cream, and her hair is wrapped in a grey towel. (3) A rapid montage of medical procedures begins. A hand wearing a cream-colored latex glove holds a black and gold handheld laser device against the woman's cheek while she lies down with metal eye shields. The background shows clinical equipment and a purple cushioned bench. (4) Consecutive shots show fine needles being injected into various parts of the woman's face, neck, and inner arms. Small droplets of clear liquid and slight redness appear at the injection sites. A white and blue laser device is also shown being pressed against her neck and upper arm. (5) The woman appears again post-treatment with red marks still visible under her eyes and on her neck. She then walks through a bright, modern lobby with digital kiosks, white curved walls, and 'GLOBAL TAX FREE' signage. The camera follows her as she takes a final mirror selfie in a hallway wearing a pink top and wide-leg denim jeans.
